GOVERNMENT OF PUNJAB
DEPARTMENT OF WATER RESOURCES
NOTIFICATION
The 12th June, 2024
No.WR-IRWR04/37/2023-IW3/2047.- In exercise of the powers conferred by section 55 of the
Northern India Canal and Drainage Act with Section 3 of the aforesaid Act, The Governor of Punjab is pleased
to notify the Khasra numbers as per details given below for smooth flow of water in “Chandbhan Drain”. The
Governor of Punjab is further pleased to authorize the Executive Engineer, Mansa, Drainage-cum-Mining and
Geology Division, WRD, Punjab, District, Faridkot, to take all necessary action to remove obstructions, in case
obstructions are raised by any person. The concerned officer i.e. Executive Engineer, Mansa, Drainage-cum-
Mining and Geology Division, WRD, Punjab, District, Faridkot, may also authorize any other government officer
or any private person to remove such obstructions or carry out any activities for the aforesaid purpose.
